title: Fix CliRunner stream ownership without reviving the race
description: Correct a logging regression caused by competing owners closing the same capture buffers.
prompt: Repeated `CliRunner.invoke` calls can leave logging handlers writing to a closed stream and emit `ValueError: I/O operation on closed file`. Fix the ownership error without reintroducing the earlier free-threaded finalization race. The wrappers and mixer must have one clear owner for each underlying buffer. Add a deterministic regression test.
